_about: Maps every clause 0.2-0.28 of nj-delegate section 0 to the smoke tests (S0-S9, smoke/RESULTS.md) and the mutation ids (tests/mutation_v4.py -> MUTATION.json) it depends on. gov4.py doctor --tags FAILS a [GATE] tag whose smoke tests lack an attested PASS or whose mutants are not all killed; it promotes nothing by itself. WP6 writes the final tags from this file plus RESULTS.md and MUTATION.json; WP7's mutation suite must use exactly the mutant ids below (add ids here first, then in the suite).

tag_rule: Every clause carries exactly one of [GATE: script], [LINT: script], [HABIT]. A GATE needs (a) an attested PASS for every smoke id listed here and (b) every listed mutant killed in MUTATION.json (and, for 0.18, a clean red-team run). A clause with an empty smoke list and mutant list can only be HABIT or LINT-by-script.
